story.1:
A severe monsoon system has started causing flooding and
localized infrastructure failures across Chennai. The first
emergency reports are coming into the district control room.
Only some incidents are currently known.
story.2:
Rainfall intensifies. Water levels rise, several existing
incidents worsen, and new emergency locations begin appearing.
The same locations are now being reported by multiple channels.
story.3:
The disaster reaches peak operational pressure. Reports arrive
rapidly from many zones. People counts change, rescue operations
start, new incidents appear, duplicates multiply, and some
earlier incidents begin moving toward resolution.
story.4:
Emergency response is now underway across the city. Many earlier
incidents are being resolved, while several locations remain
active. The latest messages contain rescue confirmations,
resource fulfillment, unresolved requests, and stale information.
